invariants: Historical benchmark must identify comparable project class and sample size
Small or non-comparable samples must not produce a confident ETA or pricing recommendation
Benchmark output must expose variance or spread rather than only a single average
Customer-caused dependency delay must be separated from internal delivery cycle time
Internal rework and regression time must remain visible in learning data
Benchmark learning must not overwrite an approved customer ETA, quotation or scope
Benchmark output is planning evidence only and cannot create a customer commitment automatically
Outliers must not be silently deleted; exclusion requires documented rationale
Production or release authority is not created by benchmark evidence
